title: track_tune
description: Read or change how a camera follows, live: headroom, lead room, how far the person may drift before it moves, top speed, smoothness, how long it holds a lost person and what it does then. With only a camera it answers with the numbers as they stand. Changes apply on the next picture and are kept for the next start.

camera.title: Camera
camera.description: The camera's id. May be left out when there is only one camera.

headroom.title: Headroom
headroom.description: Space above the head, a fraction of the shot height.

lead_room.title: Lead room
lead_room.description: How far ahead of a walking person to aim, in seconds of their walk.

dead_zone.title: Dead zone
dead_zone.description: How far off centre the person may drift before the camera moves.

max_speed.title: Max speed
max_speed.description: The fastest the camera turns or zooms, 1 being its top speed.

max_accel.title: Max accel
max_accel.description: How fast the speed may change each second; lower is smoother.

lost_hold_ms.title: Lost hold ms
lost_hold_ms.description: How long to hold the shot when the person vanishes.

switch_margin.title: Switch margin
switch_margin.description: How much better someone else must score before the camera switches to them.

detect_every.title: Detect every
detect_every.description: Look for people on one picture in this many, tracking in between.

fallback.title: Fallback
fallback.description: What the camera does once the hold runs out: stay where it is, go wide, or go to a saved preset, written preset:1.
